Upgrade Order - Magic 
​
Introduction & Disclaimer
This channel lists the recommended general melee purchase/unlock progression for players to follow.
​
Last Revised: 26th October 2026
The order is subject to change at any time as prices change, updates occur, and knowledge expands
​
Please note the following assumptions:
⬥ The order assume a starting point of T70 gear 
⬥ Priorities may be different if you are doing niche content
⬥ "ROI" (meaning return-on-investment) typically means quality-of-life upgrades or typical damage increase
⬥ We do not recommend selling an item to buy another, unless it is a direct upgrade
⬥ Unlisted items are not worth buying
​
Feel free to ask in #pvm-help for a tailored list to the content that you do!
​
Magic Upgrade Order
For further information on each upgrade, check #armour-and-weapons, #perks and #perk-information, #permanent-unlocks, or #eof-specs
​
Stage 1: High ROI
⬥ Work towards everything in #unknown-channel
⬥ Guthix Staff  + unlock its special attack -  free!
⬥ Obliteration  with Entry Level Perks  -  2,419,445
⬥ Greater Concentrated Blast  -  16,596,302
⬥ Planted Feet  -  6,528,345
⬥ Kerapac's Wrist Wraps + Blast Diffusion Boots   -  8,844,354
⬥ Elite Tectonic armour    -  179,476,129
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tectonic armour is a valid less expensive alternative    -  47,016,380
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The elite version can be resold later; the regular version cannot
⬥ Cinderbane Gloves  (only if doing poisonable content) -  41,840,261
⬥ Book slot: Scripture of Jas , Amascut  or Chaotic Grimoire 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎•  -  2,651,716
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎•  -  1,837,525
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎•  -  150,000
⬥ Greater Chain  -  211,202,824
⬥ Caroming 4 switch  - TBC
⬥ Roar of Awakening  -  122,626,192
⬥ Ode to Deceit  -  113,672,716
⬥ Amulet of Souls  -  38,333,054
⬥ Grasping Rune Pouches    -  129,922,248
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use !pouches ‎to see how to fill and which spells are useable
⬥ Greater Sunshine 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If purchasing from GE -  83,228,013
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If crafting -  36,427,605
​
Stage 2: Medium ROI
⬥ All other upgrades in #unknown-channel
⬥ Reaver's Ring  (only where >96% hit chance) -  86,748,549
⬥ Biting 4  -  80,259,191
⬥ Fractured Staff of Armadyl + Erethdor's Grimoire   -  1,159,235,480
⬥ Tumeken's resplendence top + bottom   -  413,296,129 +  483,297,843
⬥ Tumeken's resplendence boots + gloves + helm -  166,400,400 +  149,207,056 +  156,973,394
⬥ Channeller's Ring  -  103,427,229
⬥ Essence of Finality (with Iban's staff)  (with ) -  166,289,662
⬥ Magma Tempest  -  287,390,444
​
Stage 3: Low ROI
⬥ Divert  -  21,108,350
⬥ Best-in-slot weapon perks
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• C4AS1 + L4E2 for dual-wield weapons   +   -  112,033,643
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• P6U4 AS4E2 for 2H weapons   +   -  88,310,671
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• AS4 is a very strong perk in its own right. If you fail going for AS4E2, feel free to use AS4 in its place for the time being.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upon getting Aftershock you'll now need it on all of your weapons for that style
⬥ Shard of Genesis Essence  -  586,493,097
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use on 
⬥ Upgrade prayers depending on content:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Affliction  -  618,835,671
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Eclipsed Soul  + Divine Rage  -  75,220,620
⬥ Vital Drain  -  182,637,671
⬥ Enchantment of Metaphysics  -  117,768,164
⬥ Corruption Blast  - Free from Raids or  39,316,575
⬥ Essence of Finality (with Guthix Staff)  (with ) -  166,289,662
⬥ Legatus' Emberstaff  -  36,437,595
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Replace  in 
⬥ Cryptbloom set  -  391,912,657
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Skip if not doing high-enrage bosses
⬥ Limitless  -  126,980,000
